claim: Lysine-specific demethylase 1 (Lsd1/KDM1a) demethylates histone H3 on Lys4 or Lys9 (H3K4/K9).
source_text: lysine-specific demethylase 1 (Lsd1/KDM1a), which demethylates histone H3 on Lys4 or Lys9 (H3K4/K9)
evidence_reasoning: This is established biochemical knowledge about Lsd1 function, supported by citations in the introduction section (Shi et al., 2004).

claim: Lsd1 is an indispensible epigenetic governor of hematopoietic differentiation.
source_text: lysine-specific demethylase 1 (Lsd1/KDM1a), which demethylates histone H3 on Lys4 or Lys9 (H3K4/K9), is an indispensible epigenetic governor of hematopoietic differentiation
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by experimental data from conditional knockout mice showing severe hematopoietic defects, as detailed throughout the results section.

claim: Lsd1 represses hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) gene expression programs during hematopoietic differentiation.
source_text: Lsd1 represses hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) gene expression programs during hematopoietic differentiation
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by integrative genomic analysis combining Lsd1 occupancy, H3K4 methylation analysis, and gene expression profiling showing upregulation of HSPC genes in Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Lsd1 acts at transcription start sites as well as enhancer regions.
source_text: We found that Lsd1 acts at transcription start sites, as well as enhancer regions
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-Seq data showing Lsd1 binding at both promoters (15%) and distal regulatory regions (40% intergenic, 38% intronic).

claim: Loss of Lsd1 was associated with increased H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 methylation on HSPC genes.
source_text: Loss of Lsd1 was associated with increased H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 methylation on HSPC genes and gene derepression
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-Seq data comparing H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 levels in wild-type and Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Failure to fully silence HSPC genes compromised differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells as well as mature blood cell lineages.
source_text: Failure to fully silence HSPC genes compromised differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells as well as mature blood cell lineages
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the combination of gene expression data showing HSPC gene derepression and phenotypic data showing differentiation defects in multiple lineages.

claim: Active promoters are typically marked by dimethylation and trimethylation at Lys4 of histone H3 (H3K4) around transcriptional start sites (TSS).
source_text: While active promoters are typically marked by dimethylation and trimethylation at Lys4 of histone H3 (H3K4) around transcriptional start sites (TSS)
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge in the field, supported by citations (Jenuwein, 2001; Kouzarides, 2007).

claim: Enhancer elements are characterized by high levels of H3K4 monomethylation and low levels of H3K4 trimethylation.
source_text: enhancer elements are characterized by high levels of H3K4 monomethylation and low levels of H3K4 trimethylation
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about enhancer chromatin marks, supported by citations (Heintzman et al., 2007; Koch et al., 2007).

claim: Lsd1/KDM1A and KDM1B are the only KDMs known with substrate specificity for H3K4me1.
source_text: Lsd1/KDM1A and KDM1B, however, demethylate monomethylated and dimethylated H3K4, but not H3K4me3... Hence, Lsd1/KDM1A and KDM1B are the only KDMs known with substrate specificity for H3K4me1
evidence_reasoning: This is established biochemical knowledge supported by citations (Shi et al., 2004; Ciccone et al., 2009).

claim: Targeted deletion of Lsd1 in mice is lethal.
source_text: Targeted deletion of Lsd1 in mice is lethal
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Wang et al., 2007, 2009a).

claim: In Lsd1−/− embryos, the egg cylinder fails to elongate and gastrulate, resulting in developmental arrest around embryonic day (E) 5.5 and loss of Lsd1−/− embryos by E7.5.
source_text: In Lsd1−/− embryos, the egg cylinder fails to elongate and gastrulate, resulting in developmental arrest around embryonic day (E) 5.5 and loss of Lsd1−/− embryos by E7.5
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Wang et al., 2007, 2009a).

claim: Human and murine Lsd1−/− embryonic stem cells (ESCs) have proliferation and differentiation defects.
source_text: Human and murine Lsd1−/− embryonic stem cells (ESCs) have proliferation and differentiation defects
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Wang et al., 2009a; Adamo et al., 2011; Whyte et al., 2012).

claim: Lsd1 may be a point of vulnerability for acute myeloid leukemia cells.
source_text: recent evidence suggests that Lsd1 may be a point of vulnerability for acute myeloid leukemia cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by recent studies cited (Harris et al., 2012; Schenk et al., 2012).

claim: Deletion of Lsd1 in hematopoietic stem cells results in pancytopenia.
source_text: Deletion of Lsd1 in hematopoietic stem cells results in pancytopenia
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by blood count data from Lsd1fl/fl VavCre newborns showing significantly reduced blood counts (Figure 1D,E).

claim: Blood counts of Lsd1fl/fl VavCre newborns were significantly reduced.
source_text: Blood counts of Lsd1fl/fl VavCre newborns were significantly reduced
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by differential peripheral blood counts shown in Figure 1D,E.

claim: Total bone marrow cellularity was reduced in Lsd1fl/fl VavCre animals but not fetal liver cellularity.
source_text: as was total BM but not FL cellularity
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by cell count data from femurae, tibiae, and fetal livers shown in Figure 1F.

claim: The hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell compartment of Lsd1fl/fl VavCre animals was vastly distorted.
source_text: the hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell compartment of Lsd1fl/fl VavCre animals was vastly distorted
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by flow cytometry analysis showing altered frequencies of stem and progenitor cell populations (Figure 1G,H).

claim: Frequency and absolute numbers of lineage-negative Sca-1+ c-Kit+ cells (LS+K+) were reduced over 30-fold in Lsd1fl/lf VavCre mice.
source_text: Frequency and absolute numbers of lineage-negative Sca-1+ c-Kit+ cells (i.e., LS+K+; encompassing hematopoietic stem cells and multipotent progenitors [MPP]) as well as lineage-negative Sca-1− c-Kit+ cells (LS−K+ cells; encompassing myeloid progenitor cells) were reduced over 30-fold in Lsd1fl/lf VavCre mice
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by quantitative flow cytometry data shown in Figure 1H.

claim: Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre LT-HSCs clustered closest with wild-type LT-HSCs in single-cell qPCR analysis.
source_text: Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre LT-HSCs clustered closest with wild-type LT-HSCs
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by hierarchical clustering analysis of single-cell qPCR data (Figure 2—figure supplement 2E,F).

claim: Control LT-HSCs generated large colonies of multipotential granulocyte, erythroid, macrophage, and megakaryocyte progenitor identity (CFU-GEMM), whereas Lsd1-deficient colonies were smaller and consisted almost exclusively of immature blasts.
source_text: Control LT-HSCs generated large colonies of multipotential granulocyte, erythroid, macrophage, and megakaryocyte progenitor identity (CFU-GEMM), whereas Lsd1-deficient colonies were smaller and consisted almost exclusively of immature blasts
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by colony morphology analysis and cell counts from methylcellulose assays (Figure 2D,F).

claim: Lsd1 knockout colonies primarily consisted of lineage-negative c-Kit+ Sca-1+ hematopoietic progenitor cells, whereas wild-type colonies were largely composed of mature Gr1+ Mac1+ myeloid cells.
source_text: Lsd1 knockout colonies primarily consisted of lineage-negative c-Kit+ Sca-1+ hematopoietic progenitor cells, whereas wild-type colonies were largely composed of mature Gr1+ Mac1+ myeloid cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by flow cytometric analysis of colony cells (Figure 2E,G–J).

claim: Lsd1-deficient bone marrow cells were unable to significantly contribute to peripheral myeloid and B and T lymphoid lineages in competitive transplantation.
source_text: Lsd1-deficient bone marrow cells were not only unable to significantly contribute to peripheral myeloid and B and T lymphoid lineages
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by peripheral blood chimerism data from competitive transplantation experiments (Figure 3B,C,D).

claim: CD150+ LS+K+ hematopoietic stem cells were almost undetectable in Lsd1-deficient transplanted mice.
source_text: CD150+ LS+K+ hematopoietic stem cells, CD150− LS+K+ multipotent progenitor cells, and various lineage-negative myeloid progenitor cells (i.e., GMP, PreGM, PreMegE, MkP, PreCFU-E, CFU-E) were almost undetectable
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by flow cytometry analysis of bone marrow from transplanted mice (Figure 3E,F).

claim: Mature Gr1high Mac1+ granulocytes were virtually absent from the peripheral blood and bone marrow of Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre mice.
source_text: mature Gr1high Mac1+ granulocytes were virtually absent from the peripheral blood and bone marrow of Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre mice
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by flow cytometry analysis showing loss of mature granulocytes (Figure 4A,B).

claim: Erythroid-specific Lsd1 deletion resulted in lethal embryonic anemia.
source_text: erythroid-specific Lsd1 deletion resulted in lethal embryonic anemia
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by phenotypic analysis of Lsd1fl/fl EpoRCre embryos showing pale fetal livers and reduced reticulocytes/erythrocytes (Figure 4D,E,F).

claim: Lsd1-deficient embryos were small and exhibited pale fetal livers at E13.5.
source_text: Lsd1-deficient embryos were small and exhibited pale fetal livers at E13.5
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by visual inspection and documentation of embryos (Figure 4F).

claim: There was a 20-fold reduction of reticulocytes and erythrocytes in Lsd1-deficient embryos.
source_text: which could be ascribed to a 20-fold reduction of reticulocytes and erythrocytes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by flow cytometry analysis of erythroid maturation stages (Figure 4D,E).

claim: Gene set enrichment analysis showed upregulation of LSK signature genes in Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre Gr1dim Mac1+ myeloid cells.
source_text: Gene set enrichment analyses showing upregulation of LSK signature genes in Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre Gr1dim Mac1+ myeloid cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by GSEA analysis of microarray data (Figure 5A).

claim: Gene set enrichment analysis showed upregulation of LSK signature genes in Lsd1fl/fl EpoRCre CD71+ c-Kit+ erythroid cells.
source_text: Gene set enrichment analyses showing upregulation of LSK signature genes in... Lsd1fl/fl EpoRCre CD71+ c-Kit+ erythroid cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by GSEA analysis of microarray data (Figure 5B).

claim: Gene set enrichment analysis showed upregulation of LSK signature genes in Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre CD150+ CD48− LSK cells.
source_text: Gene set enrichment analyses showing upregulation of LSK signature genes in... Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre CD150+ CD48− LSK cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by GSEA analysis of microarray data (Figure 5C).

claim: GSEA analyses showed derepression of hematopoiesis related Hox genes in Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre Gr1dim Mac1+ myeloid cells.
source_text: GSEA analyses showing derepression of hematopoiesis related Hox genes and HoxA9 target genes in Lsd1fl/fl Mx1Cre Gr1dim Mac1+ myeloid cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by GSEA analysis of microarray data (Figure 5E,F).

claim: A total of 25,173 Lsd1 binding sites (peaks) were identified from the ChIP-Seq data set.
source_text: In total, we identified a total of 25,173 Lsd1 binding sites (peaks) from the ChIP-Seq data set
evidence_reasoning: This is a direct result from ChIP-Seq analysis of Lsd1 occupancy.

claim: 16 out of 18 (>85%) Lsd1 binding sites identified in 32D cells were also occupied by Lsd1 in primary Gr1dim Mac1+ cells.
source_text: We chose 18 peaks for validation by ChIP-qPCR in primary Gr1dim Mac1+ cells. We found that 16 (>85%) of these binding sites were also occupied by Lsd1 in Gr1dim Mac1+ cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-qPCR validation experiments (Figure 6—figure supplement 1A).

claim: Lsd1 binding peaks were predominantly positioned at intergenic (40%) and intronic (38%) regions, with only limited binding to proximal promoters (15%).
source_text: Genome-wide analysis of Lsd1 peak distribution revealed only limited binding to proximal promoters (15%). Lsd1 binding peaks were predominantly positioned at intergenic (40%) and intronic (38%) regions
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by genome-wide distribution analysis of Lsd1 ChIP-Seq peaks (Figure 5G).

claim: Lsd1 occupied 55% of genes (1361 out of 2473) that were at least 1.5-fold upregulated in Lsd1 knockout cells.
source_text: we compared the Lsd1 ChIP-Seq binding sites with gene expression changes extracted from Gr1dim Mac1+ microarray data and found that Lsd1 occupied 55% of genes (i.e., 1361 out of 2473) that were at least 1.5-fold (p≥0.05) upregulated in Lsd1 knockout cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by integration of ChIP-Seq and microarray data (Figure 5H).

claim: No differences in global H3K4me1/me2 and H3K9me1/me2 methylation levels were detected by Western blot.
source_text: To assess the potential consequences of Lsd1 loss on global histone methylation levels, we analyzed Lsd1 substrates H3K4me1/me2 and H3K9me1/me2 by Western blot. No differences in global methylation levels were detected
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by Western blot analysis (Figure 6—figure supplement 1B).

claim: Both KO-specific promoter and enhancer peak target genes correlated highly with genes upregulated in Lsd1 knockout Gr1dim Mac1+ cells.
source_text: We mapped cell type–specific peaks to the nearest Refseq annotated genes (Figure 6—source data 1) and observed that both KO-specific promoter and enhancer peak target genes correlated highly with genes upregulated in Lsd1 knockout Gr1dim Mac1+ cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by correlation analysis between ChIP-Seq peaks and gene expression changes (Figure 6C,D).

claim: KO-specific enhancer-associated H3K4me1 peak target genes were highly enriched among the LSK signature genes (ES: 2.31; p=4.5 × 10−14).
source_text: We found that both KO-specific enhancer-associated H3K4me1 (ES: 2.31; p=4.5 × 10−14) and the promoter-associated H3K4me2 (ES: 2.60; p=9.7 × 10−19) peak target genes were highly enriched among the LSK signature genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by enrichment analysis comparing histone modification peaks with gene signatures (Figure 6E).

claim: KO-specific promoter-associated H3K4me2 peak target genes were highly enriched among the LSK signature genes (ES: 2.60; p=9.7 × 10−19).
source_text: We found that both KO-specific enhancer-associated H3K4me1 (ES: 2.31; p=4.5 × 10−14) and the promoter-associated H3K4me2 (ES: 2.60; p=9.7 × 10−19) peak target genes were highly enriched among the LSK signature genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by enrichment analysis comparing histone modification peaks with gene signatures (Figure 6E).

claim: Genes that had Lsd1 bound at both distal sites and at the promoter were highly enriched in the LSK signature (ES: 2.02; p=2.53 × 10−11).
source_text: We found that genes of group (1) were highly enriched (ES: 2.02; p=2.53 × 10−11)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by enrichment analysis of Lsd1 target genes categorized by binding location (Figure 6G).

claim: Among the genes occupied by Lsd1 at distal sites and at the promoter were Meis1, Gfi1b, Myb, β-catenin, and Runx1.
source_text: Among the genes occupied by Lsd1 at distal sites and at the promoter were Meis1, Gfi1b, Myb, β-catenin, and Runx1
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-Seq data showing Lsd1 occupancy at these specific genes (Figure 6H, Figure 6—source data 2).

claim: Lsd1 occupies distal regulatory regions as well as proximal promoters of stem and progenitor cell genes.
source_text: we established that Lsd1 occupies distal regulatory regions as well as proximal promoters of stem and progenitor cell genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by comprehensive ChIP-Seq analysis showing Lsd1 binding at both enhancers and promoters.

claim: Deletion of Lsd1 is associated with increased levels of the Lsd1 substrates H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 on enhancers and promoters of HSPC genes.
source_text: deletion of Lsd1 is associated with increased levels of the Lsd1 substrates H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 on enhancers and promoters of HSPC genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-Seq analysis comparing H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 levels in wild-type and Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Lsd1 is crucial for immature hematopoietic stem cell differentiation.
source_text: We established that Lsd1 is crucial not only for immature hematopoietic stem cell differentiation
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from multiple experimental results including colony assays, transplantation experiments, and flow cytometry analysis.

claim: Lsd1 is essential for terminal blood cell maturation in multiple lineages.
source_text: We also observed that Lsd1 is essential not only for early hematopoietic differentiation but also for the final steps of terminal blood cell maturation in multiple lineages
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by data showing granulocytic and erythroid maturation defects in lineage-specific Lsd1 knockout mice.

claim: Lsd1 is vital for LT-HSC self-renewal.
source_text: the loss of Lsd1-deficient HSCs in the competitive transplantation setting indicates that Lsd1 is also vital for LT-HSC self-renewal
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from competitive transplantation data showing loss of Lsd1-deficient HSCs over time.

claim: Lsd1 represses genes that are normally expressed in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs).
source_text: We found that Lsd1 represses genes that are normally expressed in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by gene expression profiling showing upregulation of HSPC signature genes in Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Failure to silence HSPC gene signatures during differentiation is incompatible with terminal maturation of multiple blood lineages resulting in severe pancytopenia.
source_text: failure to silence HSPC gene signatures during differentiation is incompatible with terminal maturation of multiple blood lineages resulting in severe pancytopenia
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the combination of gene expression data showing HSPC gene derepression and phenotypic data showing pancytopenia and differentiation defects.

claim: Lsd1 function in hematopoietic cells is associated with reduced methylation of H3K4me2 at transcription start sites and reduced methylation of H3K4me1 at enhancers.
source_text: we established that Lsd1 function in hematopoietic cells is associated with reduced methylation of H3K4me2 at transcription start sites and reduced methylation of H3K4me1 at enhancers
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by ChIP-Seq analysis comparing histone methylation patterns in wild-type and Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Lsd1 serves a critical role in regulating enhancer activity in hematopoietic cells.
source_text: Our findings strongly suggest that Lsd1 serves a critical role in regulating enhancer activity in hematopoietic cells
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from ChIP-Seq data showing Lsd1 occupancy at enhancers and increased H3K4me1 at enhancers in Lsd1 knockout cells.

claim: Lsd1 occupies about 30% of active enhancers in mature myeloid cells.
source_text: our data interestingly reveal that Lsd1 occupies only about 30% of active enhancers in mature myeloid cells
evidence_reasoning: This is calculated from ChIP-Seq data comparing Lsd1 occupancy with H3K27ac-marked active enhancers.

claim: Lsd1-mediated concurrent repression of enhancer and promoter activity of stem and progenitor cell genes is a pivotal epigenetic mechanism required for proper hematopoietic maturation.
source_text: our data indicate that Lsd1-mediated concurrent repression of enhancer and promoter activity of stem and progenitor cell genes is a pivotal epigenetic mechanism required for proper hematopoietic maturation
evidence_reasoning: This is the main conclusion inferred from the integration of all experimental data including ChIP-Seq, gene expression, and phenotypic analyses.

claim: Lsd1 is an epigenetic governor required broadly for repression of stem cell gene expression programs during embryonic stem cell as well as somatic cell differentiation.
source_text: We propose that Lsd1 is an epigenetic governor required broadly for repression of stem cell gene expression programs during embryonic stem cell as well as somatic cell differentiation
evidence_reasoning: This is a broader conclusion inferred from the current study's data on hematopoietic cells combined with previous studies on ES cells.

claim: Chemical inhibition of Lsd1 enzymatic activity resulted in increased apoptosis and impaired leukemogenicity of MLL-AF9- and PML-RARα-transformed cells.
source_text: These studies described that chemical inhibition of the enzymatic activity, as well as knockdown of Lsd1, resulted in increased apoptosis and impaired leukemogenicity of MLL-AF9- and PML-RARα-transformed cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Harris et al., 2012; Schenk et al., 2012).

claim: RNAi-mediated or chemical inhibition of Lsd1 enhances γ-globin expression in human erythroid cells.
source_text: Two independent studies have described that RNAi-mediated or chemical inhibition of Lsd1 enhances γ-globin expression in human erythroid cells and quite modestly in human β-locus transgenic mice
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Shi et al., 2013; Xu et al., 2013).

claim: Appreciable or complete inhibition of Lsd1 could have undesired side effects.
source_text: Sprüssel et al. (2012), Xu et al., and this study demonstrate that Lsd1 serves critical roles in hematopoietic differentiation and that appreciable or complete inhibition of Lsd1 could have undesired side effects
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the severe hematopoietic defects observed in this study and supported by other cited studies.

claim: Loss of Lsd1 protein has been suggested to destabilize the CoREST complex.
source_text: loss of Lsd1 protein has been suggested to destabilize the CoREST complex
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Lee et al., 2005; Foster et al., 2010).

claim: Destabilization of the CoREST complex has been demonstrated to result in increased global H3K56 acetylation.
source_text: which has been demonstrated to result in increased global H3K56 acetylation
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by a previous study cited (Foster et al., 2010).

claim: Lsd1 is essential for the stability of DNA methyltransferase 1 (Dnmt1).
source_text: Lsd1 is also essential for the stability of DNA methyltransferase 1 (Dnmt1; Wang et al., 2009a)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by a previous study cited (Wang et al., 2009a).

claim: Conditional Dnmt1 knockout animals show subtle hematopoietic phenotypes during steady-state hematopoiesis.
source_text: given the subtle hematopoietic phenotypes observed in conditional Dnmt1 knockout animals during steady-state hematopoiesis
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Bröske et al., 2009; Trowbridge et al., 2009).

claim: Lsd1 occupancy data from murine and human embryonic stem cells suggested that Lsd1 occupies and regulates virtually all enhancers of embryonic stem cell genes.
source_text: Lsd1-occupancy data generated from murine and human embryonic stem cells suggested that Lsd1 occupies and regulates virtually all enhancers of embryonic stem cell genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Ram et al., 2011; Whyte et al., 2012).

claim: ES cell chromatin exists in an unique and unusual configuration with widely dispersed open chromatin.
source_text: ES cell chromatin exists in an unique and unusual configuration with widely dispersed open chromatin
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by a previous study cited (Efroni et al., 2008).

claim: Following differentiation, there is extensive epigenetic reorganization.
source_text: following differentiation, there is extensive epigenetic reorganization
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by previous studies cited (Meshorer and Misteli, 2006; Efroni et al., 2008; Hiratani et al., 2010).

claim: The epigenetic profile of fetal blood cells differs from adult blood cells.
source_text: Recent genome-wide comparisons between fetal and adult hematopoietic cells have illustrated how the epigenetic profile of fetal blood cells differs from adult blood cells
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by a previous study cited (Xu et al., 2012).

claim: Lsd1 mediates its repressive functions as part of the CoREST or NuRD repressor complexes.
source_text: Lsd1 mediates its repressive functions as part of the CoREST (corepressor for element-1-silencing transcription factor; Lee et al., 2005) or NuRD (nucleosome remodeling and histone deacetylation; Wang et al., 2009b) repressor complexes
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about Lsd1 function supported by citations.

claim: Lsd1 has been implicated in gene activation when in complex with androgen or estrogen receptors through demethylation of H3K9me1/me2.
source_text: but has also been implicated in gene activation, however, only when in complex with androgen or estrogen receptors through demethylation of H3K9me1/me2
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about Lsd1 function supported by citations (Metzger et al., 2005; Ruthenburg et al., 2007; Wissmann et al., 2007).

claim: KDM2B is restricted to removal of trimethylated H3K4.
source_text: Among KDMs, KDM2B is restricted to removal of trimethylated H3K4
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about histone demethylases supported by citations.

claim: The KDM5 family (KDM5 A–D) and NO66 demethylate H3K4me2/3.

evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about histone demethylases supported by citations (Cloos et al., 2008; Lan et al., 2008; Kooistra and Helin, 2012).

claim: Histone monomethylation, dimethylation, and trimethylation of H3K4 are mediated by a group of SET domain-containing lysine methyltransferases, for example, MLL1-5 and ASH1.
source_text: Histone monomethylation, dimethylation, and trimethylation of H3K4 are mediated by a group of SET domain-containing lysine methyltransferases, for example, MLL1-5 and ASH1
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about histone methyltransferases supported by citation (Ruthenburg et al., 2007).

claim: Lsd1 is required to maintain appropriate expression levels of HSPC genes during early, as well as late hematopoietic differentiation.
source_text: These findings suggested that Lsd1 is required to maintain appropriate expression levels of HSPC genes during early, as well as late hematopoietic differentiation
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from gene expression data showing HSPC gene derepression in both early HSCs and mature lineage cells lacking Lsd1.

claim: The inability to silence HSPC genes keeps Lsd1 knockout LT-HSCs from differentiating into myeloid progenitor cells and lineage commitment.
source_text: our data suggested that the inability to silence HSPC genes keeps Lsd1 knockout LT-HSCs from differentiating into myeloid progenitor cells and lineage commitment
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the combination of gene expression data showing HSPC gene derepression and phenotypic data showing loss of myeloid progenitors.

claim: Lsd1 deficiency in granulocytic and erythroid cells resulted in erroneous derepression of stem and progenitor cell gene sets.
source_text: Lsd1 deficiency in granulocytic and erythroid cells resulted in erroneous derepression of stem and progenitor cell gene sets
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by gene expression profiling of Lsd1-deficient granulocytic and erythroid cells showing upregulation of HSPC genes.

claim: Erroneous derepression of stem and progenitor cell gene sets resulted in stark maturation defects in the mature erythroid and granulocytic cell lineages.
source_text: which resulted in stark maturation defects in the mature erythroid and granulocytic cell lineages
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the combination of gene expression data and phenotypic analysis showing maturation defects.

claim: Lsd1 is directly involved in the repression of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell genes but not in the activation of mature granulocyte genes.
source_text: suggesting that Lsd1 is directly involved in the repression of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell genes but not in the activation of mature granulocyte genes
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from enrichment analysis showing Lsd1 target genes are enriched in LSK signature but not granulocyte signature.

claim: Lsd1 represses gene expression in association with changes in H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 levels at enhancers and promoters, respectively.
source_text: These findings indicate that Lsd1 represses gene expression in association with changes in H3K4me1 and H3K4me2 levels at enhancers and promoters, respectively
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the correlation between Lsd1 occupancy, increased H3K4me1/me2 in knockout cells, and gene upregulation.
